standard.summary: clear_dataset_npz_before_train = 开始训练前删除旧的 .npz 缓存文件，强制重新生成（当数据集图像已更新时使用）。
standard.effect: 防止数据集更改后训练器仍使用旧缓存（旧缓存与新图像不匹配）。persistent_data_loader_workers 让 DataLoader worker 进程在 epoch 间保持存活（避免重复启动开销）。image_decode_backend 控制图像解码库（PIL/cv2/libjpeg-turbo）。
standard.whenToUse: 修改了训练数据集图像内容后开启 clear；数据加载速度慢时尝试 persistent_workers=True 和 image_decode_cache。
standard.avoidWhen: 数据集未修改时不要开启 clear（浪费重新生成时间）；persistent_workers 在显存有限时可能额外占用 CPU 内存。

standard_en.summary: clear_dataset_npz_before_train deletes the old .npz cache files before training starts, forcing them to be regenerated -- for use after the dataset images change.
standard_en.effect: Stops the trainer using a stale cache after the dataset changes (the old cache no longer matches the new images). persistent_data_loader_workers keeps DataLoader worker processes alive between epochs, avoiding repeated start-up cost. image_decode_backend selects the image decoding library (PIL/cv2/libjpeg-turbo).
standard_en.whenToUse: Turn clear on after changing the training images; when data loading is slow, try persistent_workers=True together with image_decode_cache.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not turn clear on when the dataset is unchanged (it wastes time regenerating), and note that persistent_workers can hold extra CPU memory when RAM is limited.

advanced.principle: .npz 缓存以图像文件名 + 分辨率为键（不包含图像内容 hash），所以图像内容更改但文件名不变时，缓存不会自动失效。clear_before_train 是手动失效机制。bucket_selection_mode 控制 Bucket 分桶算法（按总像素/按短边/按长边等不同策略）。
advanced.tradeoffs: persistent_data_loader_workers=True 会让 worker 进程长期存活（占用约 200MB~1GB 额外内存），但消除了每 epoch 重启 worker 的开销（约 2~10 秒）。

advanced_en.principle: The .npz cache is keyed by image filename + resolution (no content hash), so changing image contents without renaming does not invalidate the cache. clear_before_train is the manual invalidation mechanism. bucket_selection_mode controls the bucketing algorithm (by total pixels / short edge / long edge, etc.).
advanced_en.tradeoffs: persistent_data_loader_workers=True keeps worker processes alive long-term (about 200MB~1GB extra memory) but removes the per-epoch worker restart cost (about 2~10 seconds).
